title: Vila Nova Returns to Serie B Leadership
seoTitle: Vila Nova Leads Serie B; Goiás Climbs; Atlético-GO Holds.
subtitle: The Goiano club reclaims the top spot in the 33rd round.
excerpt: Vila Nova reclaimed Serie B leadership in the 33rd round with a 2-0 win over Náutico in Recife. Goiás climbed to ninth, while Atlético-GO remains in the G6 promotion.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Tribuna do Planalto, Diário de Goiás
contentHtml:
In the 33rd round of Serie B, Vila Nova reclaimed the leadership by defeating Náutico 2-0 in Recife, while Goiás advanced to ninth position after their victory over Operário-PR. Atlético-GO remains within the G6, maintaining hopes of promotion.

Vila Nova Returns to Leadership

The "Tigrão" (Big Tiger) secured a victory over Náutico at Estádio dos Aflitos in Recife, with goals from Everton Galdino in the 21st minute and Janderson in the 42nd, both in the first half. The triumph elevated the team to 61 points, surpassing Juventude, who reached 60 after a 2-2 draw with São Bernardo.

Goiás Climbs the Table

Goiás Esporte Clube defeated Operário-PR 2-0 at Estádio Germano Krüger in Ponta Grossa. Lourenço scored from a free-kick and Felipe Clemente added another in the first half. The victory saw the "Verdão" (Big Green) climb from 11th to ninth position, with 48 points.

Atlético-GO Maintains G6 Position

At Estádio Antônio Accioly, Atlético Clube Goianiense drew 1-1 with Sport. Geovany Soares opened the scoring, but Sport, even with Marcelo Benevenuto's expulsion, managed to equalize with Perotti in the final minutes. The "Dragão" (Dragon) remains in sixth place, with 53 points.

Other Clashes That Changed the Table

Avaí defeated Cuiabá 1-0 at Arena Pantanal, climbing to 36 points. The result also impacts the battle for permanence in Serie B. The remaining matches of the 33rd round include Fortaleza vs. CRB, Novorizontino vs. Ponte Preta, Criciúma vs. América-MG, and Botafogo-SP vs. Ceará, concluding on Tuesday.

Playoff Outlook

With the victory, Goiás keeps alive the dream of competing in the promotion playoffs, while Vila Nova strengthens its leadership position. Atlético-GO, despite a draw, remains within the playoff qualification zone, awaiting the results of upcoming matches to consolidate its place among the top six.

With information from Tribuna do Planalto, Diário de Goiás.
